remarks: The Key To Your Luxury Dream Home is here at this Meticulously Maintained 2017 Custom Built Forbes Capretto Home located in highly sought Spaulding Green.Offering 4,084 sq. ft. of finished living space across 3 levels, featuring 4 beds, 3.5 baths & open-concept floor plan ideal for everyday living & entertaining.Exterior showcases shake vinyl siding w/stone accents, architectural roof, oversized Pella windows, prof landscaping, exterior lighting, covered front porch w/seating, X-Wide concrete driveway, front walkway & an oversized 3-car attached garage. Upon entering, you’re welcomed by gleaming hardwood floors, dramatic 2 story foyer, and an elegant split staircase that immediately showcase the home’s impressive design&craftsmanship. Front Living Rm /Dining Rm offers a flex space for your needs. $20k custom wood shutters are a tasteful addition to the homes interior. The Open-Concept Chef's Eat-In kitchen flows seamlessly into the spacious family rm, creating the perfect gathering space. Kitchen features granite countertops, shaker-style cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, Dbl Ovens, center island w/breakfast seating, abundant prep space & overlooks the main living area filled w/natural light.Conveniently located off the garage is a functional mudroom w/custom cubbies & adjacent 1'st Flr laundry rm, providing the perfect everyday drop zone.The 2'nd flr Primary Suite is a private retreat featuring a tray ceiling, spacious walk-in closet, and a Spa Bath w/ dual vanities, an air-jetted soaking tub, and a tiled walk-in shower. Also on the second floor is a private ensuite bedroom with its own full bath, plus 2 additional bedrooms connected by a Jack-and-Jill full bathroom, all offering generous closet space.The professionally finished lower level adds exceptional living space with a large family room, recreation area, fitness room, egress window and abundant storage. Step outside to your own backyard oasis featuring an oversized covered patio, expansive green space, custom hardscape patio with fire pit and plenty of room for entertaining while enjoying the beautifully landscaped yard.Some Rooms Virtually Staged for Design & Layout. A Must See To Appreciate!
